about.text: I am Ashiq Elahi, a results-driven Store In-Charge and IT & Digital Services professional with experience in retail operations, sales reporting, POS reconciliation, inventory control, verification reporting, Microsoft Office, AI tools, and WordPress. I combine operational discipline with strong digital and administrative skills to improve accuracy, efficiency, and service quality.
exp1.title: Store In-Charge – SASCO, Al-Shuhada Store #10811, Riyadh
exp1.li1: Oversee daily store operations across three shifts, monitor sales performance, and prepare accurate sales and financial reports.
exp1.li2: Manage cash handling and POS reconciliation across multiple payment types.
exp1.li3: Control inventory through regular audits, minimize shrinkage, and ensure timely replenishment.
exp1.li4: Coordinate with suppliers and submit weekly warehouse replenishment orders within deadlines.
exp2.title: Computer Operator – Verification & Reporting, Insight Management System
exp2.li1: Compiled field verification reports for bank loan and credit card applicants.
exp2.li2: Verified identity, employment, and residence information as a third-party agency.
exp2.li3: Maintained accurate digital records using Microsoft Word and Excel.
exp3.title: IT & Digital Services – Talimul Quran Was Sunnah Internet Madrasa
exp3.li1: Managed financial records, student data, accounts, budgets, and digital databases using Microsoft Excel and Word.
exp3.li2: Used AI tools for content creation, automation, and productivity.
exp3.li3: Designed online learning materials and managed a WordPress-based educational website.
exp3.li4: Provided IT and digital support for teachers and students.
